खण्ड: खण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, broken, torn asunder, divided, having chasms, gaps, or breaks; deficient, defective, crippled; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a break, a gap, a chasm, a fissure, a fracture (e. g. केदार-खण्ड, a gap or fracture in the embankment of a field); a piece, part, fragment, portion; a section of a work, part, chapter; a party number, multitude, assemblage; a term in an equation; (अस्), m. treacle or molasses partially dried, candied sugar; a flaw in a jewel; N. of a people; (अम्), n. a kind of salt (विड्-लवण), black salt; a sort of sugar-cane; [cf. उत्तर-खण्ड, कर्क°, काल°, काशी°।] —खण्ड-कटक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), title of an astronomical work com-posed by Brahma-gupta. —खण्ड-कथा, f. a fragmentary tale; a tale or story divided into sections (?). —खण्ड-कर्ण, अस्, m. a kind of bulbous plant; sweet potato. —खण्ड-काव्य, अम्, n. a fragmentary poem; a poem interspersed with prose (?). —खण्ड-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a mountain. —खण्ड-ज, अस्, m. a kind of sugar, treacle, molasses, = गुड, यवास-शर्करा. —खण्ड-जोद्भवज (°ज-उद्°), अस्, m. a kind of candied sugar prepared from Khaṇḍaja. —खण्ड-ता, f. the being divided, division. —खण्ड-देव, अस्, m., N. of the author of a commentary on Jaimini's Nyāya-sūtras, called Bhāṭṭadīpikā; also of the Mīmāṃsā-Kaustubha. —खण्ड-द्रव्य, अस्, m., N. of a man. —खण्ड-धारा, f. shears, scissors; a kind of dance or air (?). —खण्ड-पत्त्र, अम्, n. a bundle of various leaves. —खण्ड-परशु, उस्, m. an epithet of Śiva as cutting his foes to pieces with his axe. —खण्ड-पर्शु, उस्, m. a N. of Śiva; of Paraśu-rāma; of Rāhu; an elephant with a broken tusk; a spreader of unguents or fragrant powders &c.; a drug, commonly called Khandāmalaki (see खण्डा-मलक). —खण्ड-पाणि, इस्, m., N. of a prince. —खण्ड-पाल, अस्, m. a confectioner, seller of sweetmeats (for खण्ड-पाण?). —खण्ड-प्र-लय, अस्, m. a partial destruction of the universe in which all the spheres beneath Svarga or heaven are dissolved in one common ruin; a quarrel; the dis-solution of the bands of friendship or of society; (in the latter sense more correctly खण्ड-प्रणय।) —खण्ड-प्रशस्ति, इस्, f., N. of a poem attributed to Hanumat; an older N. for the play Hanuman-nā-ṭaka. —खण्ड-फण, अस्, m. a kind of serpent. —खण्ड-मण्डल, अम्, n. a segment of a circle, part of a circle, an incomplete sphere; (अस्, आ, अम्), gibbous, not full or round. —खण्ड-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of pieces. —खण्ड-मोदक, अस्, m. a kind of sugar, granulated or candied (यवास-शर्करा). —खण्ड-लवण, अम्, n. a kind of salt (विड्-लवण), black salt. —खण्ड-शर्करा, f. candied sugar or sugar in pieces. —खण्ड-शस्, ind. in pieces, by pieces, bit by bit, piece by piece, piece-meal; खण्डशः कृ, to divide or cut into pieces; खण्डशो भू, to be divided, to be separated into pieces. —खण्ड-शाखा, f., N. of a plant, = महि-ष-वल्ली. —खण्ड-शीला, f. a loose woman, an un-chaste wife. —खण्ड-सर, अस्, m. a kind of sugar (यवास-शर्करा), candied sugar. —खण्डाभ्र (°ड-अभ्°), अम्, n. scattered clouds; खण्डक: खण्डक, अस्, आ, अम्, breaking to pieces, de-stroying, removing, rendering ineffectual; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a fragment, a part, a piece; (अस्), m. treacle or molasses partially dried, candied sugar; one who has no nails; pared or clipped finger-nails (?); N. of a metre, = आर्या-गीति; a kind of dance or tune (?); [cf. खण्ड-धारा।] —खण्डकालु or खण्ड-कालुक (°क-आलु), अम्, n. an esculent root, sweet potato.
खण्डन: खण्डन, अस्, आ, अम्, breaking, dividing, cutting, reducing to pieces, destroying, annihilating, removing; (अम्), n. the act of breaking or cutting or dividing, hurting, injuring, injury; interrupting, disappointing, frustrating; cheating, deceiving; refuting (in argu-ment); rebellion, opposition; discarding, dismissal. —खण्डन-कार, अस्, m. an epithet of Harṣa. —खण्डन-कृत्, त्, m., N. of an author. —खण्डन-खण्डकाद्य (°क-आद्°), अम्, n. title of a work on logic by Harṣa. —खण्डन-रत, अस्, आ, अम्, skilful in cutting or destroying, destructive.
खण्डनीय: खण्डनीय or खण्डितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be broken or divided, frangible, fragile, brittle; destruc-tible, refutable, &c.
खण्डल: खण्डल or खण्डव, अस्, अम्, m. n. a piece, a part.
खण्डिक: खण्डिक, अस्, m. a sugar-boiler, a sugar-baker (?); pease; the armpit; N. of a man; (आ), f. the pod of pease; a kind of air or tune in music.
खण्डित: खण्डित, अस्, आ, अम्, cut, torn, broken in pieces, scattered, dispersed, destroyed; broken as allegiance, disobeyed against, rebelled; refuted, controverted; disappointed, betrayed, abandoned as a lover; (आ), f. a woman whose husband or lover has been guilty of infidelity. —खण्डित-विग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, maimed, mutilated. —खण्डित-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose manner of life is dissolute, an immoral man. —खण्-डिताशंस (°त-आश्°), अस्, आ, अम्, disappointed, foiled, frustrated.
खण्डिन्: खण्डिन्, ई, इनी, इ, consisting of pieces, in pieces or parts; divided, comminuted; (ई), m. a wild kind of kidney-bean, = Vana-mudga; a N. of Harṣa; (इनी), f. the earth.
खण्डीकृ: खण्डी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-तुम्, to divide or break into small pieces, to cut up, tear to pieces &c.
खण्डीर: खण्डीर, अस्, m. a kind of kidney-bean, Pīta-mudga.
खण्डु: खण्डु = खण्ड, a kind of sugar (?).
खण्डेराय: खण्डेराय, अस्, m., N. of an author.
खण्ड्य: खण्ड्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be broken or divided, fragile, destructible, &c.
खण्वखा: खण्वखा खण्वखा, f. (an onomatopoetic word), Ved., N. of a frog.
खत्त: खत्त खत्त, अस्, m., N. of an astronomer.
खद्: खद् खद्, cl. 1. P. खदति, चखाद, अखदीत् and अखादीत्, &c., to be steady or firm, to strike, hurt, kill; to eat (?); [cf. Lat. clades.]
खदिर: खदिर, अस्, m. the tree Acacia Catechu, having very hard wood, the resin of which is used in medi-cine, called Catechu, Khayar, Terra Japonica; an epithet of Indra; the moon; N. of a man; (ई), f. a sensitive plant, Mimosa Pudica; (sometimes also खदिरा।) —खदिर-कुण, अस्, m. the fruit time of the Khadira tree. —खदिर-पत्त्रिका or ख-दिर-पत्त्री, f. a sensitive plant, a kind of Mimosa (खदिरी). —खदिर-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of the wood of Khadira. —खदिर-वण, अम्, n. a Khadira forest. —खदिर-वणिक, अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist Bhikṣu. —खदिर-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, overgrown with Khadira; (ती), f., N. of a region. —खदिर-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a king. —ख-दिर-स्वामिन्, ई, m., N. of a scholiast. —खदिरो-पम (°र-उप्°), अम्, n. a kind of Mimosa (क-दर).
खदिरक: खदिरक, अस्, m., N. of a mountain.
खदिका: खदिका खदिका, आस्, f. pl. fried or parched grain.
खदूरक: खदूरक खदूरक, अस्, m., N. of a man; (अम्), n. a dwarf.
खन्: खन् खन्, cl. 1. P. खन: खन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. digging; rooting up.
खनक: खनक, अस्, ई, अम्, digging, digging up, dividing; a digger, excavator; (अस्), m. a miner; a house-breaker, a thief; a rat; N. of a friend of Vidura.
खनत्: खनत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, digging, digging up, ex-cavating.
खनन: खनन, अम्, n. the act of digging, excavating; digging into the earth, burying.
खननीय: खननीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be digged, to be ex-cavated.
खनि: खनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. digging or rooting up; (इस् or ई), f. a mine, especially of precious stones; a quarry, a cave. —खनि-नेत्र or खनी-नेत्र, अस्, m., N. of a prince with the epithet Karandhama.
खनितृ: खनितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a digger, delver, excavator, ditcher.
खनित्र: खनित्र, अम्, n. an instrument for digging, a spade, shovel, hoe, pickaxe; (अस्), m., N. of a prince.
खनित्रक: खनित्रक, अम्, n. or खनित्रिका, f. a small shovel or scoop.
खनित्रिम: खनित्रिम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. produced by digging.
खन्य: खन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be digged or excavated.
खात: खात, अस्, आ, अम्, dug, dug up, excavated; torn, rent; (अम्), n. digging a hole; an excavation; a ditch, fosse, moat, well; a cavern; a square or oblong pond; (आ), f. an artificial pond; [cf. देव-खात, &c.] —खात-भू, ऊस्, f. a moat, ditch. —खात-रूप-कार, अस्, m. a potter.
खात खात, खाति, खात्र। See rt. खन्।
खातक: खातक, अस्, m. a digger, delver; a debtor [cf. खादक]; (इका), f. a ditch; (अम्), n. a moat, ditch.
खात्र: खात्र, अम्, n. a spade, shovel, hoe; a moat, a square or oblong pond; a wood; a thread; horror.
खान: खान, अस्, m. digging. —खानोदक (°न-उद्°), अस्, m. the cocoa-nut tree.
खान खान, खानिल, खान्य। See rt. खन्।
खानक: खानक, अस्, इका, अम्, one who digs, a digger.
खानि: खानि, इस्, ई, f. a mine.
खानिक: खानिक, अम्, n. an opening or hole in a wall, a breach.
खानिल: खानिल, अस्, आ, अम्, a house-breaker; (sometimes read खानिन।)
खान्य: खान्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be digged.
खेय: खेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be dug, to be excavated; (अम्), n. a ditch, a moat.

खपुर: खपुर ख-पुर, अस्, m. (fr. 3. ख and पुर?), flatulence; the betel-nut tree, Areca Faufel or Catechu; the tree Cyperus Pertenuis (भद्र-मुस्तक); a kind of perfume, = व्याल-नख; (अम्), n. a city in the sky, epithet of Hiraṇya-pura, the city of the Kālakeyas; also N. of the city of Hariścandra; a water-jar.
खम्ब्: खम्ब् खम्ब्, cl. 1. P. खम्बति, -बितुम्, to go or move.
